validationClassLegend.CODE_STATIC: Discharged by reading/analysing source or configuration.
validationClassLegend.LOCAL_AUTOMATED: Discharged by local test suites / gates / disposable-database migration replay.
validationClassLegend.SINGLE_AUTHORIZED_BROWSER: One driven browser session (signed-in Aura Reviewer, or a signed-out visitor) plus production API/DB reads.
validationClassLegend.TWO_ACCOUNT_TWO_BROWSER: Two distinct identities in two browsers — sender/receiver, permitted/refused.
validationClassLegend.MULTI_PARTY_REALTIME: Three or more simultaneous participants in one realtime session.
validationClassLegend.PRODUCTION_READ_ONLY: Read-only probes against the production database/API.
validationClassLegend.EXTERNAL_INFRASTRUCTURE: An action outside the agent's authority — Cloudflare/R2 dashboard, Railway deploy, app-store release.
validationClassLegend.FOUNDER_EXPERIENTIAL: Founder observation, acceptance, sign-off, or a decision only the founder may make.
validationClassLegend.UNKNOWN: Evidence does not establish a validation topology.
